teamSeason.foot: “Ø” marks per-match averages over the complete season. “%” marks cumulative ratios — sum of hits divided by sum of attempts, not the mean of per-match ratios. When a metric is missing in the data, we show “not available” — no fabricated zeros.

matchPreview.formContextWcTournament: Form: all World Cup matches so far
matchPreview.foot: Form window: up to five most recent completed matches of the current season. Before season start, the previous season in full. During the World Cup: through Group Stage Matchday 1, all qualifying matches of the team; from Group Stage Matchday 2 onward, all completed World Cup matches so far (cumulative, no five-game cap). “Ø” marks per-match averages over the window. “%” marks cumulative ratios — sum of hits across all matches divided by sum of attempts, not the mean of per-match ratios. When a metric is missing in the data, we show “not available” — no fabricated zeros.
matchPreview.footWc: World Cup form window: through Group Stage Matchday 1, all qualifying matches of the team; from Group Stage Matchday 2 onward, all completed World Cup matches so far (cumulative). “Ø” marks per-match averages over the window. “%” marks cumulative ratios — sum of hits across all matches divided by sum of attempts, not the mean of per-match ratios. When a metric is missing in the data, we show “not available” — no fabricated zeros.
matchPreview.footDataGap: If a team has no completed fixtures in the configured World Cup qualifying competitions, that team's form values stay at “-” (data gap, no fallback).
